title: Generate exact Git Staging Connector release from API FILES manifest

phases.objective: Eliminate duplicated Connector file allowlists by deriving a deterministic release package solely from the API FILES registry inside an exact-commit Git archive; prove source and image hashes and Docker BuildKit exclusion of unlisted files.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact-Git-archive Docker build and Connector Agent image asset verifier
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only the manifest-declared Connector files are packaged, nested workflow sources stay excluded, and missing/extra image entries continue to fail closed.
steps: Prepare the exact Git archive Staging context and dynamically materialize a release under .staging-connector-release from the Connector Agent FILES registry.
Confirm raw local-connector files are excluded and only the generated bundle crosses the Docker build-context boundary.
Run source verifier and Local Manager release-owner regression tests, verifying no duplicated per-file .dockerignore allowlist.
Build a real Docker BuildKit fixture with future nested and unlisted Connector sources and require only manifest-listed release assets.
Verify the generated manifest hash is sealed in build provenance and enforced in the final Staging image.
Verify a newly declared safe Connector file is auto-packaged without any Docker ignore edit; reject subsequent file tampering.
Run the read-only n8n source inventory test, including simulated new backups, safety-flag rejection and proof that Connector FILES registry remains independent.
assertions: The FILES registry in connectorAgentRoutes.js is the only release file-list authority; adding a valid new file requires no .dockerignore update.
Source paths must be ordinary non-empty tracked file types within the trusted allowlisted prefixes, with symlink and traversal checks.
Release artifacts come from exact Git-archive sources, not locally ignored untracked Connector files or operator secrets.
Only .staging-connector-release/** is admitted to Docker context; raw local-connector/** remains denied.
The generated release manifest has deterministic per-file SHA-256 hashes and the image verifier confirms both contents and the provenance manifest digest.
The image verification rejects unexpected files and directories; BuildKit copy acceptance checks synthetic unlisted content is excluded.
No production, DB, secrets, authority bypass, or live Staging deployment occurs as part of CI.
A valid newly declared release file extends the generated manifest automatically, and content tampering fails SHA-256 manifest verification.
New BuildKit and release-growth tests are registered under the existing Connector test authority, with no new waiver or bypass.

Historical n8n backup templates and paired restore scripts remain discoverable via a read-only source inventory, independent of Connector image packaging and without restoring or changing live n8n workflows.
The changed critical E2E declaration is registered in both Constitution.control_plane_paths and derived-state convergence automation_control_paths, preserving non-waiverable manual merge governance.
